lines.text: Twitch Drop: Ensemble Sorcerer's Grassy Garb runs Aug 11 to Sep 8, and the PokemonXP and 2026 Worlds event is now fully detailed for Aug 25-30
Darkmoon Faire is confirmed for Sep 5-12, with the Midnight Dungeon Event and PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill closing the window Sep 8-15
Pokopia is now on version 2.0.0: the free Dive update and Expansion Pass Part 1, Bubbly Basin, both landed Aug 5
GO Pass: July, Choose Your Path: Fairy Trail, Trial of Style, and August's Darkmoon Faire have all ended

needs_you.action: Finish Summer Marathon's free Timed Research before it expires today at 8pm local
Turn in the Turbulent Timeways weekly Timewalking quest for its Heroic Cache of Quel'Thalas Treasures before the event ends Aug 11
Spend your double-rate Illusionary Coins on Decor Duels rewards before Curse of Ula'tek removes the mode Aug 11
Close out Season 1 raid Feats, Keystone Master, PvP and Delve rewards before the season ends
Claim Summer Marathon GO Pass rewards before they expire at 8pm local
Evolve Nickit by 9pm local on Community Day to get Thievul with Icy Wind
Buy the $4.99 Starmie Super Mega Raid Day ticket before it leaves the shop at 5pm local on event day
Claim Ultra Unlock: Water Festival GO Pass rewards by 8pm local
Finish the August Traveler's Log for the Ensemble: Midnight Outlaw and spend or freeze Tender before the Sep 1 rollover
Claim GO Pass: PokemonXP and 2026 Worlds rewards by 7:59pm local
Watch 4 hours of WoW on Twitch and claim the Sorcerer's Grassy Garb drop before Sep 8 at 10:00 a.m. PDT
Claim GO Pass: August rewards before they expire at 10am local (rank earning already ends Sep 8 at 10am)
Use the GO Pass Deluxe Lucky Trinket before it expires at 11:59pm local
Buy the World of Warcraft BlizzCon Bundle before it leaves the Battle.net Shop Sep 28

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Turbulent Timeways V
timeline.detail: The finale week runs Dragonflight Timewalking through Aug 11, and the weekly Timewalking quest still pays a Heroic Cache of Quel'Thalas Treasures at item level 259-276.

timeline.title: Decor Duels: Final Surge
timeline.detail: Play Decor Duels in Silvermoon City for double Illusionary Coins and spend them before Curse of Ula'tek removes the mode Aug 11; decor moves to Voidlight Marl vendors afterward.

timeline.title: Last chance: Midnight Season 1
timeline.detail: Blizzard's last call covers the Ahead of the Curve and Cutting Edge Feats for the Dreamrift, the Voidspire, and March on Quel'Danas, the Keystone Master mounts, and the Season 1 PvP and Delve rewards.

timeline.title: Trading Post: Showdown
timeline.detail: August's black-and-white western rotation offers the Hateforged Blazecycle (500 Tender), Badlands Buzzard (550), and Grandmaster's Royal Board (700), with the Ensemble: Midnight Outlaw as the Traveler's Log bonus reward.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath Void mount, Ensemble: Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix, Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28.

timeline.title: Catch the Drift subscription promo
timeline.detail: Buy a 6 or 12 month subscription to unlock the Sunflare Driftmoth skyriding mount and the Sunflutter Driftmoth pet for Classic progression realms.

timeline.title: Patch 12.1: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The update opens the Coiled Isle with the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Curse Surges and Cursed Fishing, the three-boss Altar of Fangs dungeon, three new Delves, Lairs, and housing blueprint saving.

timeline.title: Twitch Drop: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb
timeline.detail: Link Battle.net to Twitch and watch 4 hours of any World of Warcraft channel between Aug 11 and Sep 8, both at 10:00 a.m. PDT, to claim the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb.

timeline.title: Free T-Shirt Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Visit the vendor NPCs across Azeroth during this one-day micro-holiday to collect the free shirt cosmetics.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: The eight-boss Venomous Abyss opens Aug 18 on Normal, Heroic, Mythic and Raid Finder Wing 1 alongside Mythic+, PvP and Delve Season 2; Story Mode and Wing 2 follow Aug 25, Wing 3 Sep 1, Wing 4 Sep 8.

timeline.title: Northrend Cup
timeline.detail: Fly Northrend skyriding race courses in Normal, Advanced, and Reverse modes for Riders of Azeroth Badges and cosmetics.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire
timeline.detail: Darkmoon Island reopens Sep 5 for tickets, profession quests, and the monthly carousel and top-hat experience buffs.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Aug 4 (now): Dragonflight Timewalking closes Turbulent Timeways at the Aug 11 reset; PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk

Week of Aug 11: Curse of Ula'tek launches at the reset with Heroic and Mythic 0 dungeons, Prey and Delves Season 2 openers, and the Tidebound Grotto Lair at World difficulty; World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Free T-Shirt Day Aug 16
Week of Aug 18: Season 2 proper, Mythic+, PvP and the Venomous Abyss raid open; Battleground Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble
Week of Aug 25: Pet Battle Bonus Event and Northrend Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Northrend Cup begins Aug 25; raid Story Mode and Raid Finder Wing 2 open
Week of Sep 1: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu; Raid Finder Wing 3; Darkmoon Faire returns Sep 5
Week of Sep 8: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill; Raid Finder Wing 4; the Twitch Drop window closes Sep 8
just_past_window: Sep 15-22: Cataclysm Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Classic Ashran
Sep 19-20: Pirates' Day, with Brewfest starting Sep 20 and running to Oct 6
Sep 21-28: Harvest Festival, and the Arena Skirmish Bonus Event Sep 22-29

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: Summer Marathon: Arctic Embers
timeline.detail: Shiny Snom's debut week closes tonight: finish the free Timed Research (16,800 XP and a Pikachu wearing a marathon visor) by 8pm local, then claim GO Pass rewards by Aug 12 at 8pm.

timeline.title: GO Pass: August
timeline.detail: Rank toward a Latias encounter with the Lucky Trinket as the final Deluxe reward; Deluxe is $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, points are uncapped Sep 5-6, rank earning ends Sep 8 at 10am local, rewards expire Sep 10 at 10am, and the Trinket expires Sep 13.

timeline.title: LEGO Stores and Pokemon GO
timeline.detail: Participating US LEGO Stores host boosted Pikachu raids, a stamp rally leading to Special Background Pikachu, a LEGO-branded avatar jacket via Timed Research, and a SMART Play demo with a collectible tag; everything must be claimed by Sep 30 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Venom and Vines
timeline.detail: Pick Explore, Catch, or Battle at 10am local on Aug 11 for a week of tailored Timed Research; the choice is locked once made and everything expires Aug 17 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Nickit Community Day
timeline.detail: Catch Shiny-boosted Nickit with 3x catch Stardust and 2x Candy, and evolve it by 9pm local for Thievul with Icy Wind; the optional $1.99 Special Research adds three Special Background Nickit.

timeline.title: Ultra Unlock: Water Festival
timeline.detail: Arrokuda, Barraskewda, and Cramorant debut alongside Shiny Ducklett and Dewpider boosts; catch bonuses climb to 4x XP and 5x Stardust from Aug 22, and GO Pass rewards expire Aug 26 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Starmie Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Starmie debuts in Super Mega Raids with boosted shiny odds and up to 6 free Raid Passes from Gym spins; the optional $4.99 ticket (in shop until 5pm local) raises that to 14 plus guaranteed Rare Candy XL per catch.

timeline.title: PokemonXP and 2026 Worlds
timeline.detail: Pikachu in a Cosmog-themed spacesuit debuts Aug 25, World Championships 2026 Pikachu joins Aug 28, GO Battle League jumps to 15 sets a day, and the event GO Pass (Deluxe $4.99, or $6.99 with 6 ranks) must be claimed by Sep 1 at 7:59pm local.

timeline.title: GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale
timeline.detail: The summer-ending global GO Fest runs Sep 5-6 with details still to come; GO Pass: August points are uncapped that same weekend.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local this season; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Thu Aug 13: Spotlight Hour, Wurmple, 2x evolution XP
Thu Aug 20: Spotlight Hour, Magikarp, 2x catch XP
Thu Aug 27: Spotlight Hour, Mankey, 2x catch Candy (September lineup not yet posted)
Max Mondays: Aug 10 Beldum, Aug 17 Magikarp, Aug 24 Hitmontop, Aug 31 Eevee (all Dynamax)
5-star raids: Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf through Aug 11; Groudon Aug 12-18; Lunala Aug 19-25; Regirock, Regice, and Registeel Aug 26 - Sep 8 (Raid Hours Aug 12, Aug 19, Aug 26, and Sep 2)
Shadow Raids (weekends): Shadow Giratina (Altered Forme) through Sep 8
Mega Raids: Blaziken through Aug 11, Garchomp Aug 12-18, Swampert Aug 19-25, Gyarados Aug 26 - Sep 8

GO Battle League: Master League and Evolution Cup (Great League Edition) Aug 11-18; Great League and Scroll Cup Aug 18-25; GL, UL, and ML Aug 25 - Sep 1; GL, UL, and ML Mega Edition Sep 1-8; Worlds arena and music Aug 24 at 12pm PDT to Aug 30 at 11:59pm PDT
The Forever Forward season ends Sep 8 at 10am local; the next season has not been announced yet
just_past_window: Nov 14-15: Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026 returns; no events are dated yet between Sep 15 and Sep 28

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, code entry) for a placeable Chansey Plant; codes are region free and valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the internet Mystery Gift option, no code needed; available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now
timeline.detail: Part 1, Bubbly Basin, is live on the eShop and needs the Bleak Beach environment request plus the new Dive move; buying the pass by Aug 31, 2027 also mails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots, valid through Sep 30, 2027.

timeline.title: Fetching Scales for Feebas
timeline.detail: Feebas visits town asking for help collecting Prism Scales, which trade for event items including habitat pieces for Feebas and Milotic.

just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 arrives in late 2026 with new accessories, furniture and Pokemon but no new town; Part 3 and its new town follow in 2027

games.typical_lead_time: official news posts land 1-2 weeks ahead; no launch date announced yet

timeline.title: Global launch
timeline.detail: The Global Closed Beta ended Jul 25 and wiped all data; anyone who sealed an Aniimo in the Bond Pact event reclaims that egg at launch by logging in with the same account and channel.
timeline.estimate_basis: No launch date from Pawprint; Steam still lists Coming soon as of Aug 10
